verdict.rationale: The pack never documents Supermemory itself tracking when facts became valid or invalid, so it cannot be credited with temporal reasoning. The comparison page's 'No temporal truth' line describes a shortcoming of an unnamed alternative, not an affirmative Supermemory capability. The isStatic flag, profiles that update over time and date metadata filtering are related features but do not model fact validity over time.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can track when facts became valid or invalid (temporal reasoning) so the memory distinguishes current from outdated information
